bib.title: Pivotal Tuning for Latent-based Editing of Real Images

question: How can a real, possibly out-of-domain face image be inverted into StyleGAN so that it is reconstructed faithfully and still edited with latent-space editors, avoiding the distortion-editability trade-off?
hypothesis: Because StyleGAN is disentangled, a slight local change to the generator can map an image to an editable W pivot code without damaging the latent space's editing behaviour.
contributions: Pivotal Tuning Inversion: invert to a W pivot, then fine-tune the generator around the pivot
Locality regularization that keeps the tuning from disturbing distant latent codes
Multi-identity tuning of a single generator
Quantitative and qualitative gains in reconstruction and editing over SG2, SG2 W+ and e4e

method.summary: Step 1 inverts the image to a pivot code w_p in StyleGAN2's W space by direct optimization (LPIPS + noise regularization) with the generator frozen. Step 2 unfreezes the generator and fine-tunes its weights so G(w_p) reproduces the image (LPIPS + L2), with a locality regularizer that keeps images from interpolated latents unchanged. Edits are then done with off-the-shelf latent editors (InterfaceGAN, GANSpace, StyleCLIP).
method.task: GAN inversion and latent-based real image editing (faces)

datasets.name: FFHQ
datasets.source: used to pretrain the StyleGAN2 generator (not trained by this work)

datasets.name: CelebA-HQ
datasets.size: first 1000 samples of the test set for all quantitative experiments
datasets.source: Karras et al. 2017; Liu et al. 2015

datasets.name: Collected web images of famous and out-of-domain faces

models.name: SG2 (W optimization)
models.architecture: Karras et al. direct optimization to W

models.name: e4e
models.architecture: encoder (Tov et al.) to W+ near W

training.objective: Per-image generator fine-tuning: L_pt = LPIPS(x,x_p) + lambda_L2 * L2(x,x_p), plus lambda_R * L_R where L_R = LPIPS + lambda_R_L2 * L2 between original and tuned generator on w_r = w_p + alpha*(w_z-w_p)/||w_z-w_p||_2 (w_z = mapping(z)); w_p held constant. Inversion step: LPIPS + lambda_n * noise regularization over w and n.
training.regularisation: locality regularization: alpha = 30, lambda_R_L2 = 1, lambda_R = 0.1, N_r = 1
training.compute: two-step inversion under 3 minutes per image
training.wall_clock: W inversion ~1 min; pivotal tuning under 1 min without regularization, under 2 min with; grows linearly with number of identities; SG2 W+ 4.5 min; e4e under 1 s

other.inversion_hyperparameters: same as Karras et al. [19] except lr

inference.samples: 1000 CelebA-HQ test images; seeds not stated
inference.prompting: StyleCLIP mapper variant uses e4e-based pivots instead of W pivots

metrics.name: LPIPS
metrics.definition: perceptual similarity between input and reconstruction

metrics.name: ID similarity
metrics.definition: similarity from a pretrained face recognition network (ArcFace)

metrics.name: Edit magnitude (pose)
metrics.definition: yaw rotation angle after a single pose edit, measured with Microsoft Face API

eval.protocol: Quantitative on first 1000 CelebA-HQ test images; ID similarity after single edits (smile, pose, age), sequential edits, and at fixed +-5 and +-10 rotation; no seeds or significance tests.

evidence.quote: except for the learning rate which is changed to 5e−3

limits: Optimization per image (about 3 min) rather than a feed-forward pass; authors want a trainable mapper approximating PTI.
Only StyleGAN2 faces tested; BigGAN or other generators left as future work.
Single image per identity; a set of photos per individual is future work.
Without locality regularization, tuning many identities causes artifacts and ID shift on distant latents.
StyleCLIP needs e4e-based pivots, not W pivots.
No seeds, variance or significance tests for Tables 1-2; lambda_n not stated; web images not enumerated.
Compared only against SG2, SG2 W+ and e4e; Richardson et al. pSp excluded.

terms.definition: a brief training process that preserves the editing quality of an in-domain latent region, while changing its portrayed identity and appearance
closer to W gives better editability but more distortion; W+ gives less distortion but weaker editability
